Capability manifest for nav_menu/1 (the .pc-navmenu container) — keen-pure-admin. See layout.map.json / footer.map.json for the model. nav_menu/1 renders
    {inner_block}
; with `collapse` set it forces a generated id + the PureAdminNavFitCollapse hook + phx-update=ignore + data-pc-fit-nav*, so collapse is capability-only (not strict-compared — the generated id can't reconcile with svelte's id-free SSR). Items come from nav_item/nav_dropdown sub-components (container-only). Shared SSR features: the items slot, the collapse capability (menu|sidebar), the root class passthrough.
